# Overview

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Keep outputs readable and figures consistent across studies.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

#set seed
set.seed(123)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(here)
  library(BayesFactor)
  library(emmeans)
  library(survival)
  library(survminer)
  library(rstanarm)
  library(bridgesampling)
  library(showtext)
})

base_font <- tryCatch({
  font_add(
    "Inter 24pt",
    regular = "Inter_24pt-Regular.ttf",
    bold = "Inter_24pt-Bold.ttf",
    italic = "Inter_24pt-Italic.ttf",
    bolditalic = "Inter_24pt-BoldItalic.ttf"
  )
  "Inter 24pt"
}, error = function(e) "sans")
showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)

#set common theme
theme_set(
  theme_classic(base_family = base_font, base_size = 48) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 20)),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.clip = "off",
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 80)
    )
)
```

# Study 1

## Data

```{r}
#read in data
df.study1_raw <- read.csv(here("data", "sc_study1_final.csv"))

#clean data and recode values
df.study1 <- df.study1_raw |>
  select(id,
         age,
         gender,
         condition,
         exclude,
         peek = peeked,
         time,
         protocol) |>
  filter(exclude == 0) |>
  mutate(condition = ifelse(condition == 0, "Other", "Self")) |>
  mutate(time = as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(time), 180, time)),
         age_c = age - mean(age))
```

## Demographics

```{r}
#age
df.study1 |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            age_mean = mean(age),
            age_sd = sd(age),
            age_min = min(age),
            age_max = max(age))

#gender
df.study1 |>
  count(gender)

#number of participants peeking by condition
df.study1 |>
  count(condition, peek)

#excluded participants
df.study1_raw |>
  filter(exclude == 1) |>
  count(exclude_reason)
```

## Analyses

```{r}
#fisher test
fisher.test(table(df.study1$condition, df.study1$peek))
```

```{r}
#survival results
study1.model <- survfit(Surv(time, peek) ~ condition, data = df.study1)

study1.model |>
  summary()

survdiff(Surv(time, peek) ~ condition, data = df.study1) |>
  print(digits = 10)

```

```{r}
#age effects
study1_age_model <- glm(peek ~ condition * age_c, data = df.study1,
                        family = binomial)

#condition effect at the mean age
emmeans(study1_age_model, ~ condition) |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE)

#age slope averaged across conditions
emtrends(study1_age_model, ~ 1, var = "age_c") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE)

#age by condition interaction 
emtrends(study1_age_model, ~ condition, var = "age_c") |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE)

#age effects on peek latency
study1_latency_model <- coxph(Surv(time, peek) ~ condition * age_c,
                              data = df.study1)

#age slope averaged across conditions (as a hazard ratio)
emtrends(study1_latency_model, ~ 1, var = "age_c") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(c(age_c.trend, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL), exp))

#age by condition interaction (as a hazard ratio)
emtrends(study1_latency_model, ~ condition, var = "age_c") |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(c(estimate, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL), exp))

#age bins
df.study1 |>
  group_by(age_bin = floor(age), condition) |>
  summarise(peeked = sum(peek), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
#slightly different study protocol results
df.study1 |>
  count(protocol, condition, peek)
```

## Figures

```{r}
#peeking by condition figure
p.study1_peek <- ggplot(data = df.study1,
                        mapping = aes(x = condition,
                                      y = peek,
                                      color = condition)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0,
              width = 0.4,
              alpha = 0.3,
              size = 4.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot",
               geom = "pointrange",
               size = 4,
               linewidth = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Self = "#BA8E23", Other = "#00b159")) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Self", "Other")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(y = "Prop. Peeking",
       x = "Condition")

ggsave(here("figs", "study1_peek_binary.png"), p.study1_peek,
       width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
#survival figure
p.study1_surv <- ggsurvplot(
  study1.model,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  pval = FALSE,
  palette = c("#00b159", "#BA8E23"),
  break.x.by = 60,
  legend = "none",
  ggtheme = theme_get()
)

p.study1_surv <- p.study1_surv$plot +
  theme_get() +
  labs(y = "Survival Probability", x = "Time (seconds)")

ggsave(here("figs", "study1_surv.png"), p.study1_surv,
       width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# Study 2

## Data

```{r}
#read in data
df.study2_raw <- read.csv(here("data", "sc_study2_final.csv"))

#clean data and recode values
df.study2 <- df.study2_raw |>
  select(id,
         age,
         gender,
         condition,
         exclude,
         peek,
         time) |>
  filter(exclude == 0) |>
  mutate(peek = as.numeric(peek),
         condition = ifelse(condition == 0, "Other", "Self")) |>
  mutate(time = as.numeric(ifelse(is.na(time), 180, time)),
         age_c = age - mean(age))
```

## Demographics

```{r}
#age
df.study2 |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            age_mean = mean(age),
            age_sd = sd(age),
            age_min = min(age),
            age_max = max(age))

#gender
df.study2 |>
  count(gender)

#number of participants peeking by condition
df.study2 |>
  count(condition, peek)

#excluded participants
df.study2_raw |>
  filter(exclude == 1) |>
  count(exclude_reason)
```

## Analyses

```{r}

#fisher test
fisher.test(table(df.study2$condition, df.study2$peek))

#survival results
study2.model <- survfit(Surv(time, peek) ~ condition, data = df.study2)

study2.model |>
  summary()

survdiff(Surv(time, peek) ~ condition, data = df.study2) |>
  print(digits = 10)

```

```{r}
#age effects

study2_age_model <- glm(peek ~ condition * age_c, data = df.study2,
                        family = binomial)

#condition effect at the mean age (Self - Other, log-odds)
emmeans(study2_age_model, ~ condition) |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE)

#age slope averaged across conditions
emtrends(study2_age_model, ~ 1, var = "age_c") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE)

#age by condition interaction (difference in age slopes, Self - Other)
emtrends(study2_age_model, ~ condition, var = "age_c") |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE)

#age bins
df.study2 |>
  group_by(age_bin = floor(age), condition) |>
  summarise(peeked = sum(peek), n = n(), .groups = "drop")


#age effects on peek latency
study2_latency_model <- coxph(Surv(time, peek) ~ condition * age_c,
                              data = df.study2)

#age slope averaged across conditions (as a hazard ratio)
emtrends(study2_latency_model, ~ 1, var = "age_c") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(c(age_c.trend, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL), exp))

#age by condition interaction (as a hazard ratio)
emtrends(study2_latency_model, ~ condition, var = "age_c") |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(c(estimate, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL), exp))

```


```{r}
#analysis without the erroneously excluded participant
df.study2_dropped <- df.study2 |>
  filter(id != "SC_Study2_13")

#fisher test
fisher.test(table(df.study2_dropped$condition, df.study2_dropped$peek))

#survival results
study2.model_dropped <- survfit(Surv(time, peek) ~ condition,
                                data = df.study2_dropped)

study2.model_dropped |>
  summary()

survdiff(Surv(time, peek) ~ condition, data = df.study2_dropped) |>
  print(digits = 10)

```

# Studies 1 and 2 combined

## Data

```{r}
#combine study 1 and 2 data
df.studies12 <- bind_rows(
  df.study1 |>
    mutate(study = "Study1") |>
    select(condition, age, peek, time, study),
  df.study2 |>
    mutate(study = "Study2") |>
    select(condition, age, peek, time, study)
) |>
  #age_c: mean-centered on the pooled sample
  mutate(condition = factor(condition),
         study = factor(study),
         age_c = age - mean(age))
```

## Analyses

```{r}
#condition by study interaction
study12_model <- glm(peek ~ condition * study + age_c, data = df.studies12,
                     family = binomial)

#condition effect averaged across studies (Self - Other, log-odds)
emmeans(study12_model, ~ condition) |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE)

#study effect averaged across conditions (Study 2 - Study 1, log-odds)
emmeans(study12_model, ~ study) |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE)

#age slope
emtrends(study12_model, ~ 1, var = "age_c") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE)

#condition by study interaction
emmeans(study12_model, ~ condition * study) |>
  contrast(interaction = "revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE)

#peek latency: condition by study interaction
study12_latency_model <- coxph(Surv(time, peek) ~ condition * study + age_c,
                               data = df.studies12)

#condition effect averaged across studies (as a hazard ratio)
emmeans(study12_latency_model, ~ condition) |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(c(estimate, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL), exp))

#age slope (as a hazard ratio)
emtrends(study12_latency_model, ~ 1, var = "age_c") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(c(age_c.trend, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL), exp))

#condition by study interaction (as a hazard ratio)
emmeans(study12_latency_model, ~ condition * study) |>
  contrast(interaction = "revpairwise") |>
  summary(infer = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(c(estimate, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL), exp))

#age bins
df.studies12 |>
  group_by(age_bin = floor(age), condition) |>
  summarise(peeked = sum(peek), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

# Study 3

## Data

```{r}
#read in data
df.study3_raw <- read.csv(here("data", "sc_study3_final.csv"))

df.study3 <- df.study3_raw |>
  filter(exclude == 0) |>
  mutate(age_c = age - mean(age))
```

## Demographics

```{r}
#age
df.study3 |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            age_mean = mean(age),
            age_sd = sd(age),
            age_min = min(age),
            age_max = max(age))

#gender
df.study3 |>
  count(gender)

#number of participants choosing self
df.study3 |>
  count(choice)

#choice by gender
df.study3 |>
  count(gender, choice)

#excluded participants
df.study3_raw |>
  filter(exclude == 1) |>
  count(exclude_reason)
```

## Analyses

```{r}
#number choosing self
study3_choseself <- df.study3 |>
  pull(choice) |>
  sum(na.rm = TRUE)

study3_totaln <- df.study3 |>
  nrow()

study3_choseself
study3_totaln

#bayes factor
proportionBF(study3_choseself, study3_totaln, p = 0.5)

#prior sensitivity
proportionBF(study3_choseself, study3_totaln, p = 0.5, rscale = "wide")
proportionBF(study3_choseself, study3_totaln, p = 0.5, rscale = "ultrawide")

#binomial test
binom.test(study3_choseself, study3_totaln, p = .5)

#age effects
study3_age_model <- stan_glm(choice ~ age_c, data = df.study3,
                             family = binomial, refresh = 0, seed = 123)

#age slope (posterior median and 95% HPD interval)
emtrends(study3_age_model, ~ 1, var = "age_c")

#age bins
df.study3 |>
  group_by(age_bin = floor(age)) |>
  summarise(chose_self = sum(choice), n = n())
```

## Figures

```{r}
#choice figure
p.study3_choice <- ggplot(data = df.study3,
                          mapping = aes(x = "",
                                        y = as.numeric(choice))) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0,
              width = 0.4,
              alpha = 0.3,
              size = 4.5,
              color = "#4C6EBC") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot",
               geom = "pointrange",
               size = 4,
               linewidth = 4,
               color = "#4C6EBC") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) rep(" ", length(x))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(y = "Prop. Choosing Self",
       x = " ")

ggsave(here("figs", "study3_choice.png"), p.study3_choice,
       width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# Study 4

## Data

```{r}
#read in data
df.study4_raw <- read.csv(here("data", "sc_study4_final.csv"))

#clean data and recode values
df.study4 <- df.study4_raw |>
  filter(exclude == 0) |>
  select(id, age, gender, condition, choice, color) |>
  #condition: 1 = bird tracing (High Uncertainty), 0 = line tracing (Low
  #Uncertainty)
  mutate(age_bin = ifelse(age >= 5, "Five-year-old", "Four-year-old"),
         age_c = age - mean(age),
         condition = factor(ifelse(condition == 1, "High Uncertainty",
                                   "Low Uncertainty"),
                            levels = c("Low Uncertainty", "High Uncertainty")))
```

## Demographics

```{r}
#age
df.study4 |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            age_mean = mean(age),
            age_sd = sd(age),
            age_min = min(age),
            age_max = max(age))

#gender
df.study4 |>
  count(gender)

#number of participants choosing self by condition
df.study4 |>
  count(condition, choice)

#excluded participants
df.study4_raw |>
  filter(exclude == 1) |>
  count(exclude_reason)
```

## Analyses

```{r}
#bayesian models
study4_model_full <-
  stan_glm(
    choice ~ condition,
    data = df.study4,
    family = binomial,
    refresh = 0,
    seed = 123,
    diagnostic_file = file.path(tempdir(), "diag_file_full_study4.csv")
  )

study4_model_null <-
  stan_glm(
    choice ~ 1,
    data = df.study4,
    family = binomial,
    refresh = 0,
    seed = 123,
    diagnostic_file = file.path(tempdir(), "diag_file_null_study4.csv")
  )

set.seed(123)
bridge_full_study4 <- bridge_sampler(study4_model_full, silent = TRUE)
set.seed(123)
bridge_null_study4 <- bridge_sampler(study4_model_null, silent = TRUE)

#bayes factor
bayes_factor(bridge_full_study4, bridge_null_study4)$bf

#condition effect (High - Low, posterior median and 95% HPD interval)
emmeans(study4_model_full, ~ condition) |>
  contrast("revpairwise")

#fisher test
fisher.test(table(df.study4$condition, df.study4$choice))

#contingency table bayes factor; for comparison; not pre-registered
contingencyTableBF(table(df.study4$condition, df.study4$choice),
                   sampleType = "indepMulti",
                   fixedMargin = "rows")
```

    family = binomial,

    family = binomial,
    refresh = 0,
    seed = 123,
    diagnostic_file = file.path(tempdir(), "diag_file_null_study4_fours.csv")
  )

set.seed(123)
bridge_full_study4_fours <- bridge_sampler(study4_fours_model_full,
                                           silent = TRUE)
set.seed(123)
bridge_null_study4_fours <- bridge_sampler(study4_fours_model_null,
                                           silent = TRUE)

#bayes factor
bayes_factor(bridge_full_study4_fours, bridge_null_study4_fours)$bf

#condition effect (High - Low, posterior median and 95% HPD interval)

### Prior sensitivity

```{r}

study4_prior_scales <- c(0.25, .5, 1, 2.5, 5, 7.5, 10)

study4_prior_sensitivity <- tibble(prior_scale = study4_prior_scales,
                                   bf = NA_real_)

#get bfs for each prior width
for (i in seq_along(study4_prior_scales)) {
  prior_scale <- study4_prior_scales[i]

  study4_prior_model <- stan_glm(
    choice ~ condition,
    data = df.study4,
    family = binomial,
    prior = normal(0, prior_scale, autoscale = FALSE),
    refresh = 0,
    seed = 123,
    diagnostic_file = file.path(
      tempdir(),
      paste0("diag_file_full_study4_prior", prior_scale, ".csv")
    )
  )

  set.seed(123)
  study4_prior_sensitivity$bf[i] <-
    bayes_factor(bridge_sampler(study4_prior_model, silent = TRUE),
                 bridge_null_study4)$bf
}

study4_prior_sensitivity
```

```{r}

df.study4_prior_reported <- study4_prior_sensitivity |>
  filter(prior_scale == 5)

study4_prior_labels <- as.character(study4_prior_scales)
study4_prior_labels[study4_prior_scales == 0.5] <- "\n0.5"

p.study4_prior_sensitivity <- ggplot(data = study4_prior_sensitivity,
                                     mapping = aes(x = prior_scale,
                                                   y = bf)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "grey50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 8) +
  geom_point(data = df.study4_prior_reported,
             color = "#C1553A",
             size = 10) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = study4_prior_scales,
                     labels = study4_prior_labels) +
  labs(y = expression(BF[10]),
       x = "Prior SD") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 20, 5.5, 20))

ggsave(here("figs", "study4_prior_sensitivity.png"), p.study4_prior_sensitivity,
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
